environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2), running as a systemd service under the 'app' user. The service listens on port 3000 and is directly exposed via an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no application-layer inspection. No rate limiting configured. The ENCRYPTION_KEY environment variable is set in /etc/systemd/system/token-service.env. Error responses are returned directly to the client with distinct HTTP status codes (400 vs 422) enabling padding oracle differentiation.

config.network: public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 3000
